info.name: HPE OmniStack REST backups omnistack_clusters API
Retrieves all defined omnistack_clusters on the system

params.name: show_optional_fields
params.description:
An indicator that specifies the capacity metrics, time_zone, upgrade_state, and upgrade_task_id of the omnistack_cluster

Note: These values are computed from various sources. Consequently, the retrieval of these values may adversely affect the response time of a request.

params.name: id
params.description:
The unique identifier (UID) of the omnistack_clusters to return

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list

params.name: name
params.description:
The name of the omnistack_clusters to return

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list, pattern using one or more asterisk characters as a wildcard

params.name: hypervisor_object_id
params.description:
The unique identifier (UID) of the hypervisor-based instance associated with the objects to return

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list

params.name: hypervisor_object_parent_id
params.description:
The unique identifier (UID) of the hypervisor-based instance that contains the objects to return

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list

params.name: hypervisor_object_parent_name
params.description:
The name of the hypervisor-based instance that contains the objects to return

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list, pattern using one or more asterisk characters as a wildcard

params.name: hypervisor_management_system_name
params.description:
The name of the hypervisor-based instance associated with the omnistack_cluster

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list, pattern using one or more asterisk characters as a wildcard

params.name: type
params.description:
The type of omnistack_clusters to return

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list

params.name: cluster_group_id
params.description:
The unique identifiers (UIDs) of the cluster_groups associated with the omnistack_clusters to return

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list

params.name: arbiter_address
params.description:
The address of the Arbiter connected to the objects to return

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list

params.name: arbiter_connected
params.description:
An indicator to show if the omnistack_cluster is connected to Arbiter

 Valid values:

True: Only returns omnistack_clusters connected to Arbiters that you identified in arbiter_address

False: Only returns omnistack_clusters not connected to Arbiters that you identified in arbiter_address

params.name: arbiter_required
params.description: An indicator to show if an Arbiter is required in this omnistack_cluster

params.name: arbiter_configured
params.description: An indicator to show if an Arbiter is configured in this omnistack_cluster

params.name: fields
params.description:
A comma-separated list of fields to include in the returned objects

 Default: Returns all fields

params.name: limit
params.description:
A positive integer that represents the maximum number of results to return

Default: 500

params.name: offset
params.description:
A positive integer that directs the service to start returning the <offset value> instance, up to the limit

Default: 0

params.name: case
params.description:
An indicator that specifies if the filter and sort results use a case-sensitive or insensitive manner

Valid values: sensitive or insensitive

Default: sensitive

params.name: sort
params.description: The name of the field where the sort occurs

params.name: order
params.description:
The sort order preference

Valid values: ascending or descending

Default: descending

items.docs: Retrieves all defined omnistack_clusters on the system
